error_message: New detached Seeder worktree existed but tem/sdr submodule files were absent
recovery_action: Run self-locating initialize_submodules.sh through direct WSL script-file transport

error_message: WSL Git attempted to use unreachable 127.0.0.1:29758 proxy while initializing pinned submodules
recovery_action: Switch submodule URLs to locally pinned repositories and retry through a self-locating script

error_message: Git rejected local pinned submodule repositories because file transport was disabled
recovery_action: Enable protocol.file.allow=always for the submodule initialization command only

error_message: Build preflight used incorrect full hashes that shared the verified 667109df and 53f273db prefixes
recovery_action: Replace transcribed hashes with git rev-parse full values from the pinned worktree and rerun preflight

error_message: Waf compiled and linked build/seeder but post-build junit summary failed with ModuleNotFoundError: six
expected_path: Python module six used by waflib.extras.junit_xml
recovery_action: Install the small WSL Python build dependency with a recorded script, verify import, and rerun the incremental build

error_message: Validation tool launched by file path without inserting the repository root, so import utils failed
recovery_action: Use the repository tool convention to insert ROOT into sys.path before research-module imports; rerun validation without rerunning Seeder

error_message: Join-Path was given an unsupported third positional component while copying frozen STL inputs
recovery_action: Resolve and validate the in-workspace target, compose the directory first, then append each filename with a second Join-Path call

error_message: The reusable analytic-cylinder q oracle assumed a cylinder centred at the global origin and therefore misclassified every link in the translated periodic case.
recovery_action: Made the research-only q oracle consume the explicitly recorded wall.center_m; retained the successful mesh and did not spend another Seeder call.

error_message: Musubi tracking files were present and non-empty but direct Win32 opening failed because the generated descriptive path exceeded the legacy path limit.
recovery_action: Use the Windows extended-length path prefix in the research-only ASCII reader; retain solver outputs and do not repeat the Musubi call.

error_message: PowerShell Move-Item archived the main tracking directory but hit the legacy path limit on a later small log file.
recovery_action: Verified both resolved endpoints remain inside the exact case directory and completed remaining individual file moves with .NET extended-length paths; no solver call involved.

error_message: The explicit staging whitelist accidentally suffixed the Seeder patch path with .py, so that git add invocation staged nothing.
recovery_action: Correct the exact whitelist entry and retry without broad staging.

error_message: Git could enumerate but could not index a deeply nested archived Musubi preflight log under the legacy Windows path limit.
recovery_action: Enable repository-local core.longpaths and rerun the same explicit staging whitelist.
